dataset: semantic/experiments/fixtures/questions.jsonl (30 cases, 6 categories x 5, synthetic Chinese corpus)

approval.reason: native comparison is unmeasured (blocked on isolated test deployment + model credentials) and all thresholds below are proposed from semantica-mode measurements on a controlled 14-node corpus only

permission_leak_count.basis: semantica run 2026-09-11, 30 cases; leak gate checks hit content objects, node names, related ids, cited quotes and evidence ids, case-insensitive

hard_gates.note: permission leak is an absolute hard gate; no average may compensate (V03 spec)

correct_rate_min.basis: floor = measured minus observed variance margin on 30 controlled cases

evidence_recall_mean_nonempty_min.basis: measured mean recall over the 20 cases with non-empty expected evidence (empty-expected recall is definitional 1.0 and excluded)

evidence_precision_mean_min.basis: keyword retrieval over-cites incident facts; production adapter (Q01) must improve before tightening

multihop_correct_rate_min.basis: upstream related-expansion follows outgoing edges only; direction-aware expansion is Q01 scope and must raise this

unanswerable_correct_rate_min.basis: keyword retrieval cannot judge absence; explicit insufficiency determination is Q03 scope and must raise this

latency_hot_p95_max_ms.basis: controlled 14-node in-memory corpus; 10ms is headroom on this corpus only, NOT a production-scale claim

tokens_per_query_max.basis: retrieval-only evaluation, no model invoked; model-mode token thresholds pending credentials

native_mode.blocked_reason: requires an isolated TEST deployment of the existing WeKnora graph services (SEMANTICA_EXPERIMENT_NATIVE_URL) plus extraction-backed graph data and model credentials; production URLs are forbidden

comparison_gates.note: spec section 9: semantica must meet or beat native on the same corpus before any backend switch; numbers deferred until native runs
